map.输入粉刷面积、涂层厚度、涂刷遍数与涂料密度，计算总用量与采购桶数，适用于墙面翻新: Input painting area, coating thickness, coats and paint density to compute total usage and purchase buckets, for wall-renovation material budget.
map.翻新刷墙，量房间周长×层高减门窗得涂刷面积，按『面积÷单桶涂布率』算桶数。: Renovation painting: measure room perimeter x ceiling height minus doors/windows for painting area, compute bucket count by "area / per-bucket spreading rate".
map.两遍腻子+一遍底漆+两遍面漆时，分遍累加用量，避免只算面漆漏底。: For two coats of putty + one coat of primer + two coats of topcoat, accumulate usage per coat to avoid counting only topcoat and missing primer.
map.对比滚涂与喷涂的损耗，喷涂省料但设备贵，小面积滚涂更划算。: Compare loss of roller vs spray coating; spray saves material but equipment is costly; small areas roller is more economical.
map.：涂刷面积 60㎡，面漆 2 遍，单桶涂布 10㎡/遍\n需 = 60 × 2:
: painting area 60 m^2, topcoat 2 coats, one bucket covers 10 m^2/coat
need = 60 x 2 / 10 = 12 m^2-coat / 10 = 1.2 buckets -> buy 2 buckets
map.涂布率怎么定？: How to set the spreading rate?
map.看产品标注（㎡/L 或㎡/桶），并乘损耗系数；多孔、深色基层吃漆多，涂布率下降。: Check product label (m^2/L or m^2/bucket) and multiply by loss coefficient; porous, dark substrates absorb more paint and lower the spreading rate.
map.腻子和漆分别算吗？: Are putty and paint counted separately?
map.是。腻子按 kg/㎡、漆按 L/㎡，单位不同；本工具分遍累加，注意单位换算。: Yes. Putty by kg/m^2, paint by L/m^2, different units; this tool accumulates per coat, mind unit conversion.
map.新墙/翻新建议底漆封碱抗碱、提升面漆附着；省底漆易返碱、掉粉，长期更不划算。: New wall / renovation: primer seals alkali and improves topcoat adhesion; skipping primer easily causes alkali return and powdering, less economical long-term.
